speakers.biographyMd:
For years in internet technologies, he has gained experience in the design, development and maintenance of reliable and stable IT infrastructures.
Naturally brought to problem solving, he is passionate about complex systems, starting from their comprehension, through the identification of critical issues, up to their optimization and improvement.
Currently involved in the design and development of a new high performance all purpose API infrastructure.
